release_notes: Orbitra 2.1.1 hotfix: the v2.1.0 merge accidentally dropped the v2.0.4 Analytics frontend. The Trends page is restored (pinned Total row, click-to-sort columns, the "Show me on an example" walkthrough, chart redraw on metric toggles, weekday names in the UI language). Table headers follow their column alignment again. Unique clicks now agree across pages (uniq_global across campaigns, uniq_campaign in campaign views) as promised in 2.1.0. The retention seam note in Trends works.
